hints.title: Bijection Mapping Across Variable Length Tokens
hints.text: Because word boundaries are unstated, test all substring lengths for each pattern letter while enforcing one-to-one bidirectional uniqueness.

hints.title: Pruning with Existing Mappings
hints.text: If a pattern symbol already maps to a word, check if the string prefix matches that word exactly, advancing without trying other segment lengths.

hints.title: Backtracking with Forward Match Search
hints.text: Maintain two maps p2w and w2p. If pattern[p] is bound, verify string match and recurse. If unbound, test all end indices k, checking that substring s[s_idx:k] is not yet mapped.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Worst-case combinatorial branching across string partitions with rapid pruning via bijection checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of word lengths without bidirectional binding pruning creates immense exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual dictionaries ensure instant O(1) membership checks to abort conflicting mappings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain both pattern-to-word and word-to-pattern maps to ensure a true bijection.
